description: Direct deploy for CI/agent workflows: builds the app in a server sandbox (npm install + vite build) and publishes the dist to Final web-hosting as a new live version. Two things stop a deploy: a failing build, and a hardcoded credential (a build is distributable to other companies, so a baked-in secret would ship to all of them — use request_secret). Guardrail and type findings do NOT block; run validate_flow first if you want them. Omit `changelog` and the release notes are drafted for you from what changed since your last deploy — call log_message (or pass `note` on write_flow_files) as you work so those notes describe intent rather than just file names. Uses your organization's provisioned hub credential automatically (the same long-term org JWT the extension tools use) — no token argument needed once you've connected. Pass `hostingToken` only as an escape hatch to override it; if no credential is available, reconnect via the Connect dialog or use open_in_builder and deploy from the Launch tool instead.

hostingToken.description: Organization JWT accepted by hosting.finalpos.com. Optional escape hatch — omit to use your organization's stored hub credential (the same long-term org JWT the extension tools use).
